pages.title: Common Configuration
pages.text: The common file is $(thing)auram-common.toml$() inside your server or singleplayer $(thing)config$() directory. Stop the server before editing and restart it to apply a complete configuration change.$(br2)Sections:$(br)$(thing)["Chaos Generation"]$()$(br)$(thing)["LLM Config"]$(). Rock appearance is automatic and has no config switch.

pages.title: Quest Settings
pages.text: In $(thing)["Chaos Generation"]$():$(br2)$(thing)questsUseLLM = false$() keeps text generation offline.$(br2)$(thing)questThreads = 0$() uses available processors. Choose 1–64 to set the quest worker count explicitly. This affects quest generation, not the recipe chaos worker pool.

pages.title: Unused Settings
pages.text: The same section declares:$(br)$(thing)defaultDifficulty = 50$()$(br)$(thing)varianceMultiplier = 1.9$()$(br)$(thing)debugMode = false$()$(br2)The current generator does not read these three values. They do not change its difficulty, EMC bounds or logging. Supply difficulty explicitly in the command; modifier bounds are currently defined in code.
